d: Chestnut brown hair is styled into two small buns on top with long side-locks and blunt bangs, framing a youthful face with a playful, winking expression and large, sparkling chocolate-brown eyes. The build is petite and slender, dressed in an orange sailor-style top with white trim, a dark brown necktie, and a matching orange apron worn over a dark brown pleated skirt. Signature details include dark brown fingerless gloves and heavy grey metallic mechanical rigging attached to the hips.
